elements.title: Le pont
elements.note: When a public holiday (« un jour férié ») falls on a Thursday, many people in France take the Friday off too and get a four-day weekend: that is « faire le pont » (literally, to make the bridge). A day off work is « un jour de congé »; « en congé » means on leave.
